hypothesis.title: Separate anchored and free component execution
hypothesis.evidence: Source audit: isolated no-live-bond chunks are already omitted by labelDeviceStressBonds/rootFlags and labelDeviceStressNodes, so the original empty-system hypothesis has no reachable target. Current common component kernel retains free-projection code/resources even for the overwhelmingly anchored iterative work. N10 uses108 registers,32.09% occupancy in the later selected capture.
hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Use separate GPU-owned anchored/free work queues and template the component recurrence/preparation/preconditioning so the anchored specialization omits certified zero-dimensional nullspace work and its compiler resource footprint. Current validated mode dimension selects ownership; free components retain all projection. Preserve current equations and per-component numerical order; no CPU count readback.
hypothesis.estimated_application_ms_saved: Potential1–5 ms heavy mean if reduced anchored register/shared footprint improves residency; charge queue preparation and extra launch. No established saving.
hypothesis.confidence: high semantic equivalence under current mode certificate; medium compiler/resource benefit
hypothesis.experiment_cost: Private GPU component queues and templated recurrence/preconditioner, kernel launch updates; original free/anchored/interleaved/cap/topology tests, sanitizers, full A/B and counters
hypothesis.supporting_measurements: Both queue ownership and original physical gates pass, anchored resources fall, complete-step heavy mean/peaks improve without idle regression; independent queues enable later size decomposition
hypothesis.refuting_measurements: Queue divergence or invalid certificate, resource footprint unchanged, extra launch/cache costs erase benefit, full-suite regression
hypothesis.reassessment: Original no-live-interface singleton target removed before experiment: native topology already omits those rows. This audit does not count as a completed experiment.
hypothesis.baseline_scope: Current snapshot-compatible runtime includes unaccepted N14 numerical work. This experiment does not promote N14 or replace frozen N13.
hypothesis.source_review: Mode readiness checked before class selection; both passes initialize verification to zero; successful small components keep their own results/history. No per-component floating atomics or changed reduction order. Extra list scan, cursor reset and launch are charged. Free kernel retains all projection. Large cooperative stage is unchanged.

measurements.repetition_policy: Equal per-process counts in A-before/B/A-after; all first-use ticks included at equal weight. Pooled controls have twice the candidate sample count.
measurements.scope: One full tick per independent physical restore. A-before / B / A-after per scenario. All CPU/GPU work and correction included; restore, validation and post-tick observation excluded. Unprofiled comparison with recorded GPU admission; no profiler timings or automatic acceptance.

conclusion: Reject. No convincing scenario improvement; city256 late-debris mean483.504ms versus459.421/457.057ms controls,5.51% above pooled control. Three large-case samples are screening evidence, not a precise regression estimate. Anchored specialization changes109 to108 registers, stack48 to0, shared1600 to1168bytes; free path retains original resources. No occupancy or critical-path benefit established. Additional dispatch does not earn retention or a neutral architecture exemption.

retained: Frozen N13 and main runtime unchanged; N20 remains independently under full memory qualification. No N14 promotion.
